Chapter 1203 - 19: Which Two Peak Venerables Are Battling? (Black Myth Prize Winners To Be Announced Later)_2

Chapter 1203: Chapter 19: Which Two Peak Venerables Are Battling? (Black Myth Prize Winners to Be Announced Later)_2

The reason Fu Xu Venerate stands above the Peak Venerables is that he mastered a supreme legacy passed down from the ancestors.

Each of the six Ancient Countries’ thirteenth-generation ancestors left relevant supreme legacies in their treasuries, which many Venerates attempt to cultivate, but very few actually succeed.

Cultivating and mastering are two different things.

"Is this the power of a Peak Venerable?"

The few Peak Venerables of the Da Ling Ancient Country looked at each other, their hearts inevitably uneasy.

The clash between Lin Yuan and the Spirit Prison Venerate unleashed a wave of power, which alone was equivalent to the full force of these Peak Venerables.

"The Galaxy Venerate should be a Peak Venerable."

The few Da Ling Peak Venerables silently observed, forming their judgment.

The Spirit Prison Venerate suspected that Lin Yuan had used external help to explode his right eye’s Spirit Prison, and the same speculation naturally occurred to these Peak Venerables.

After all, Lin Yuan’s rise was too rapid. Even if he carried the ancestral bloodline of a Venerate, wouldn’t growth and exploration require time?

However, after the clash before them, even though the Spirit Prison Venerate lost his right eye, his strength as a Peak Venerable remained, and he still couldn’t suppress the Galaxy Venerate in the slightest.

This was a straightforward battle.

If not a Peak Venerable, then what?

...

Rumbling! The direct clash between two Peak Venerables continually spread its power to all corners of the world.

"Is that... Peak Venerables fighting fiercely?"

The Peak Venerable of Thunderclap Ancient Country had just refined a core pillar and looked up in a certain direction, secretly curious: "Just entering the treasure grounds, and there are Peak Venerables dueling?"

Apart from the Da Fu Ancient Country, in the other five Ancient Countries, Peak Venerables are generally the limit of combat power. In the initial scramble for the treasure grounds, even if they encounter each other, they wouldn’t easily fight.

"Is one of the Peak Venerables the Spirit Prison Venerate? Who is the other?"

The Peak Venerable of Thunderclap Ancient Country gazed into the distance, pondering.

"Never mind, whoever it is, the more fiercely they fight, the better, giving me the chance to refine more core pillars."

Immediately, this Peak Venerable flew off in another direction, searching for new core pillars.

...

Meanwhile.

All the places within the treasure grounds sensed the battle between Peak Venerables.

"Is it the Spirit Prison Venerate?"

"Has the Spirit Prison Venerate encountered a foe so quickly?"

"Who is the Peak Venerable clashing with the Spirit Prison Venerate? I’ve never sensed this kind of aura before."

"However, this power is scorching and bold. It should be a Peak Venerable from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, but the three Peak Venerables sent this time by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Chi Yan, Hengyang, and Guanglie, none seem to match."

...

Many Peak Venerables, even the Peak Venerables, focused part of their attention on this battle. However, they continued their frantic search for each place’s core pillars.

...

"Spirit Prison Eternal!"

The Spirit Prison Venerate’s right eye was hollow, and his left eye was endlessly deep, subtly causing nearby realms to twist and rotate.

This move was considered one of his killer moves, specifically prepared for other Peak Venerables, but now it was being used on Lin Yuan.

"What is this?"

Lin Yuan’s expression was somewhat grave. The many Seeds of the Fierce Sun within him started to glow. Around him, within the cosmos he enveloped, thousands upon thousands of Fierce Suns ascended, and in an instant, there were 33,333 Fierce Suns suspended.

This was the first time Lin Yuan fully activated the Divine Ability ’World’ in front of others. Previously, when trapped within the right-eye Spirit Prison, no other powers watched.

"This move again?"

The Spirit Prison Venerate’s expression was fierce; his right eye had been burst open by such a relentless force of the Fierce Sun.

As rounds of Fierce Suns floated, the Spirit Prison realm released by the Spirit Prison Venerate swiftly dissolved, with 60% of its area disintegrating in no time.

"This technique has never been used by any Peak Venerables in the history of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country!" The Spirit Prison Venerate felt strained and found it hard to believe.

At this moment, he was sure that Lin Yuan’s method of bursting his right eye wasn’t from an external force but stemmed from his own strength.

"Spirit Prison Venerate, still not running?"

Rounds of Fierce Suns hovered around Lin Yuan, and he himself transformed into an even larger Fierce Sun, illuminating the universe.

"Run?"

The Spirit Prison Venerate felt aggrieved, but he knew that he indeed should run. If he continued, he would have to pay a price to take his leave.

"Galaxy Venerate, you concealed your strength and prematurely ruined one of my Spirit Prisons; otherwise, how would I have fallen behind?" The Spirit Prison Venerate’s remaining eye stared at Lin Yuan, still somewhat unconvinced.

If the right-eye Spirit Prison remained, even if unable to defeat the Galaxy Venerate, neither of the two Peak Venerables could do much harm to each other, rather than ending in his own retreat.

Two Spirit Prisons compared to one dictated a completely different strength for the Spirit Prison Venerate.

Of course, given the terrifying strength Lin Yuan displayed now, even if the Spirit Prison Venerate’s right eye were intact, it would still be difficult to overpower him; at most, it would be an equal stalemate.

"Get lost."

Lin Yuan looked down and considered that with his current strength, forcibly keeping the Spirit Prison Venerate would be challenging, and even with all his cards deployed, it would take a lot of time, and hope would be slim.

During this span, various changes could happen, such as other Peak Venerables from the Da Ling Ancient Country coming to rescue him.

Under such circumstances, it would lead to internal consumption between the Fierce Sun Ancient Country and the Da Ling Ancient Country, benefiting the other four Ancient Countries. Lin Yuan certainly wouldn’t choose to do so.

Expelling the Spirit Prison Venerate sufficed.

In fact, had the Spirit Prison Venerate not been unwilling and wanted to verify Lin Yuan’s true strength, the two wouldn’t have fought at all.

"Leave."

The Spirit Prison Venerate felt aggrieved, but he still maintained the remaining Spirit Prison realm to quickly flee.

Though the Spirit Prison realm formed by his left eye wasn’t vast, it was invincible and promptly broke through Lin Yuan’s cosmic suppression, fleeing.

As for the few Peak Venerables from the Da Ling Ancient Country at the beginning, they had already retreated far away.

Once they sensed things were going awry, they immediately withdrew.

Seeing this, Lin Yuan did not pursue further but returned to the core pillar below and immediately began refining it.

"These pillars are the core of the treasure grounds. By refining the pillars, can one somewhat control the treasure grounds?"

As the refinement continued, Lin Yuan faintly sensed the connection between this pillar and the treasure grounds.

...

In the capital of the Fierce Sun Country, within an independent space.

Embodied here were avatars of twelve Peak Venerables, including Red Flame Venerate and Venerable Guanglie, gathered to communicate at any time.

The consciousness shared between avatars and their true forms; now, these twelve Venerates dispersed throughout the newly born treasure grounds, relying on this avatar network to contact each other.

"Galaxy, why did the core pillar you found transmit the vibrations of a Peak Venerable battle?"

Red Flame Venerate immediately regarded Lin Yuan.

The other Peak Venerables heard this and similarly turned their gaze; when two Peak Venerables fought with full force, most of the treasure grounds would perceive it. Even those who hadn’t sensed it heard of it from friends.

"Galaxy, which Peak Venerable is battling the Spirit Prison?"

Venerable Guanglie was equally curious, "I could feel the aura and power of the Peak Venerable being scorching and fierce with the presence of Fierce Sun. But all twelve Venerables from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country are here."

Venerable Hengyang also watched Lin Yuan, his expression revealing some suspicion as he, too, eyed Lin Yuan curiously.

"Well, the Spirit Prison Venerate encountered me, and he lost his right eye Spirit Prison quickly." Lin Yuan spoke, his expression solemn as he explained.

This statement caused immediate silence around him.

Even though there were only eleven Peak Venerables, their hearts long sensed something.

Is the Galaxy Venerate actually a Peak Venerable?
